title: kbingest map lets a repository's global.json sdk.paths load an SDK from the worktree
goal: Before any dotnet call (the version probe included), kbingest map reads every global.json from each project folder up to the worktree root as text and, when one sets sdk.paths (.NET 10: an SDK loaded from a folder relative to global.json, per Microsoft Learn global-json), skips .NET with a note and runs no dotnet command; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_sdk_paths with a planted global.json proves no dotnet call is logged, and a planted removal of the check fails it (sprint review ST-ptn4bkh3 finding F2)
